[SWS_DM_01053] DM behavior on transmission Mode stopSending with not supported periodicDataIdentifier in the request
⌈
On reception of the UDS
Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmissionMode set to ’stopSend-
ing’ and none of the periodicDataIdentifiers of the request is supported, the DM shall
return NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange).
⌋
